newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Finnair, Braathens, Transwede unveil cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Finnair, Braathens, Transwede unveil cooperation.

text.p: Nordic airlines Finnair, Braathens Safe and Transwede said on Thursday that there were to cooperate on frequent flier programmes and fares on various routes.
"As from May 1, 1997 all Braathens Safe and Transwede's frequent flier members can use bonus points on Finnair's international flights," a join statement said.
"All members of Finnair's frequent flier programme can use points on all Braathens's and Transwede's routes."
The three airlines will also cooperate on fares so that travellers receive one price for a ticket even though there may be two or more segments with the different airlines in the journey.
Under the cooperation, Braathens Safe will also handle Finnair's arrival and departures at Fornebu airport in Oslo.
The cooperation was first unveiled last week when the three airlines announced they were joining forces in a wider cooperation as competition in the Nordic airline sector increases.
